hero.desc: Dance and movement as tools for expression and well-being. Art as a path to social transformation.

seq1.p1: There are places that do not exist on the map.

seq2.p1: is a social organization born to build these places. Spaces where dance is not only performance, but above all is presence. Where movement is more than exercise or stretching, it is listening and expression. Where art is not an end, but the beginning of an encounter.
seq2.p2: The encounter with oneself and the encounter that happens when people breathe and move at the same rhythm.
seq2.p3: Change begins in the skin, when a person rediscovers their own strength, their creativity, their own voice. And when this happens in a group, a path opens up for
seq2.p6: creates the conditions for people to meet.

card1.desc: Every body carries a dance it hasn't yet dared to step into. These workshops are the space where movement, presence and expression bring it to light.

card2.desc: Conscious movement practices that broaden perception, stimulate body reorganization and transform the way we inhabit the body.

card3.desc: Community projects that cross streets and neighborhoods, weaving ties, creating bonds and transforming.

1.title: Expression
1.desc: The body holds what words cannot express. In the workshops, movement becomes a language and creates a space where rhythm, presence and improvisation set free what has been held back.

2.title: Well-being
2.desc: Listening to the body is a political act. Conscious movement practices expand perception, reorganize physical patterns and return to people the authorship over themselves.

3.title: Creation
3.desc: Movement is raw material. From dance choreography is born, from silence the gesture is born, from the encounter the work is born. Art is what happens when the body has the freedom to express itself.

4.title: Transformation
4.desc: When people move together, something changes. Dance crosses walls, creates bonds and opens space for a transformation that begins in the body and reverberates on the street, in the neighborhood, in the city.

action.desc: Find a workshop, a class, your place. The body knows the way, just start.
action.btn2: I want to support the project

footer.desc: Transforming lives through movement and dance. A project focused on expression and social well-being.

hero.subtitle: A model for universal access to culture and movement. Premium workshops, free for residents of Gamle Oslo — sustained by multiple funding sources.

context.title: Why Gamle Oslo?
context.p1: Gamle Oslo is a neighbourhood of contrasts — diversity, history and cultural richness coexist with inequalities in access to quality services and activities. This is exactly the context that calls us to act.
context.p2: Dance2Dance is born in this territory with a clear mission: that dance, movement and well-being should not be a privilege for those who can pay. Every workshop we develop carries the same quality, the same care and the same intention — regardless of who is in the room.
context.quote: The same product. The same quality. The same value. For everyone.

value.kicker: The value of what we offer
value.title: Free does not mean without value.
value.subtitle: Those who receive it for free receive exactly the same as those who pay. We make the real price visible because perceived value matters — for supporters and participants alike.

paid.label: External participants
paid.desc: Residents from outside Gamle Oslo participate at the regular rate, with access to the same premium quality experience.

free.label: Gamle Oslo residents
free.desc: Local residents have guaranteed, free access to all workshops. No waiting lists, no distinction, no lesser quality.

value.insight: “Free access with price transparency creates dignity. The person is not receiving charity — they are receiving the opportunity to be part of something with real value.”

model.title: An ecosystem of support.
model.intro: Dance2Dance was designed not to rely on a single source. Our sustainability comes from the strategic combination of multiple pillars — each essential, none sufficient alone.

pillar1.title: Paying participants
pillar1.desc: Those who come from outside Gamle Oslo pay the real value of the workshop. This revenue directly contributes to enabling free access for local residents.

pillar2.title: Companies & sponsors
pillar2.desc: Private companies wishing to associate their brand with real social impact and quality culture find in Dance2Dance a purposeful and visible partner.

pillar3.title: Public funds & municipality
pillar3.desc: The project aligns with public policies on cultural and community inclusion, making it eligible for support from cultural funds and the City of Oslo.

pillar4.title: Individual donors
pillar4.desc: People who believe in the power of art as social transformation can support directly, becoming part of the story from the very beginning.

model.summary: The diversification of revenue sources is intentional: it ensures the project does not depend on any single entity, making it more resilient and scalable over time.

partners.title: Partners who build together.
partners.desc: Dance2Dance does not act alone. We work in network with organisations that share the conviction that art transforms and that access to culture is a right.

cta.title: Support what is still being born.
cta.desc: Funds, companies and partners who arrive now are part of the foundation — and the story — of this project. Get in touch and discover how to be part of it.
cta.btn1: I want to be a partner

hero.subtitle: Culture doesn't have to be a privilege. With the methodology of Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, we bring world-class workshops to Tøyen and Grønland residents through a plural, secure, and sustainable financing model.

context.title: The art of democratizing excellence.
context.p1: Tøyen and Grønland breathe diversity, but also face visible barriers to accessing culture. Where many see a challenge, we see the perfect ground to plant a new model of social integration.
context.p2: Backed by the technical expertise of Porto Alegre Cia de Dança, Dance2Dance offers an aesthetic and transformative experience. Knowledge and practices developed over years of artistic experience now reach the local community through dance workshops, body awareness practices, and social integration experiences.
context.quote: Excellence is not a privilege. It is an opportunity.

value.title: Perceived value. Real impact.
value.subtitle: Our free spots are not charity, they are full scholarships funded by our ecosystem. By pricing the workshop for external audiences, we prove the high value delivered to local residents and our investors.

paid.label: Paying Audience
paid.desc: Regular students attest to the quality of the service and inject revenue that fuels the social impact.

free.label: Local Community
free.desc: Residents receive unrestricted access to the same infrastructure and teachers, generating dignity and belonging.

value.insight: “Social projects that do not compromise on the highest standards of technical quality attract partners who demand excellence in their own brands.”

model.title: Smart Financial Ecosystem.
model.intro: Investors avoid projects dependent on single donors. Dance2Dance was built on 4 revenue pillars that guarantee longevity, financial security, and risk mitigation for all stakeholders.

pillar1.title: Self Revenue
pillar1.desc: Ticket sales to participants outside the impact zone cover basic costs and attest to the product's demand.

pillar2.title: Visionary Brands
pillar2.desc: Corporate sponsors who add the project to their ESG impact reports, gaining visibility and social equity.

pillar3.title: Public Funding
pillar3.desc: Strategic alignment with public policies and cultural grants from the Norwegian government, validating institutional rigor.

pillar4.title: Private Donors
pillar4.desc: Independent philanthropists who demand clear metrics and bet on the transformative power of bodily practices and access to culture.

model.summary: An antifragile model: if one source fluctuates, the financial matrix rebalances itself. Maximum security for investors, guaranteed continuity for dancers.

partners.title: Partners who build together.
partners.desc: Dance2Dance does not act alone. We work in a network with organizations that share the conviction that art transforms and that access to culture is a right.

cta.title: Associate your brand with transformation.
cta.desc: We are selecting strategic partners for Dance2Dance's founding year. Companies that join us now secure naming rights quotas and leadership in social impact in Oslo.

philosophy.title: [TODO: Translate] O QUE É O BIOSTRETCH?
content: [TODO: Translate] Biostretch é um sistema de exercícios que promove a reconexão com o corpo por meio da consciência do movimento.

[TODO: Translate] O método utiliza a atenção como sua principal ferramenta: um recurso simples, poderoso e acessível a todos. Ao direcioná-la para a experiência do movimento, ampliamos a percepção do corpo e abrimos espaço para novas possibilidades de organização corporal.

[TODO: Translate] Inspirado em mais de quatro décadas de estudos em dança, Educação Somática e meditação, o método reconhece o corpo como um sistema inteligente, integrado e em constante transformação. Em vez de buscar desempenho ou correção, propõe uma investigação sutil da experiência corporal, na qual importa menos o que se faz e mais como se faz.
[TODO: Translate] É dessa experiência de presença que nasce uma nova forma de perceber e habitar o corpo. Mas como essa transformação acontece na prática?

philosophy.title: [TODO: Translate] COMO ATUA?
content: [TODO: Translate] A prática do Biostretch convida você a desacelerar, relaxar o corpo e direcionar a atenção para movimentos simples e para as sensações que eles despertam.

[TODO: Translate] Nessa exploração, torna-se possível reconhecer padrões de tensão, hábitos de movimento e formas de organização corporal que costumam permanecer fora da nossa percepção por operarem de forma automática e inconsciente. A aparente simplicidade da prática revela um trabalho profundo de escuta, percepção e reorganização.

[TODO: Translate] Ao serem realizados de forma lenta, suave e sem esforço, os exercícios favorecem um estado de equilíbrio no sistema nervoso, responsável por coordenar a comunicação entre corpo e mente e regular as funções do organismo. Nesse estado, o corpo encontra espaço para liberar tensões, reorganizar-se e recuperar a fluidez natural do movimento.

[TODO: Translate] Mais do que ensinar novos movimentos, o Biostretch fortalece a confiança na inteligência inata do corpo e convida a redescobrir o prazer de mover-se com liberdade, presença e consciência. O melhor é que essa experiência está ao alcance de qualquer pessoa.

philosophy.title: [TODO: Translate] QUEM PODE PRATICAR?
content: [TODO: Translate] O Biostretch pode ser praticado por pessoas de todas as idades e diferentes níveis de experiência, condicionamento físico ou mobilidade.

[TODO: Translate] A prática respeita a individualidade de cada corpo. Não existe um movimento ideal a ser alcançado nem um padrão externo a ser seguido. Cada pessoa explora as sequências dentro de seus próprios limites e possibilidades, no seu próprio ritmo.

[TODO: Translate] Em vez de adaptar o corpo a um modelo, o Biostretch valoriza aquilo que cada pessoa já possui: sua capacidade de perceber, aprender e encontrar caminhos mais confortáveis e funcionais para o movimento. Assim, a prática fortalece a autonomia, a confiança e o prazer de habitar o próprio corpo.
[TODO: Translate] E o que essa prática pode transformar no dia a dia?

philosophy.title: [TODO: Translate] QUAIS OS BENEFÍCIOS?
content: [TODO: Translate] A prática regular do Biostretch contribui para aliviar tensões, ampliar a mobilidade, melhorar a postura e tornar os movimentos mais leves, coordenados e confortáveis. Com o tempo, o corpo recupera a fluidez e eficiência, tornando as atividades do dia a dia mais fáceis e prazerosas.

[TODO: Translate] Ao favorecer o equilíbrio do sistema nervoso, a prática também ajuda a reduzir os efeitos do estresse, melhorar a qualidade da respiração e aliviar dores e desconfortos associados à tensão muscular, especialmente em regiões como pescoço, ombros e costas. Além disso, contribui para prevenir lesões relacionadas a padrões repetitivos e ao uso excessivo do corpo.
[TODO: Translate] Com o tempo, essas mudanças se estendem para além da prática e passam a fazer parte da maneira como nos movemos, percebemos e utilizamos o corpo no dia a dia.

uma-melhor-postura.title: A Better Posture
uma-melhor-postura.shortDescription:
What if you could improve your posture without trying to "fix" your body?
Experience a new relationship with your body, with more support, freedom, and ease to move.
uma-melhor-postura.fullDescription:
Your posture tells a story. It reflects the way you organize your body, the habits you've developed over a lifetime, and how you relate to the environment around you.
More than a position we must hold, posture is a dynamic organization of the body to move, balance, and meet the world. It is present in everything we do and influences our sense of comfort, freedom of movement, support, and well-being.
Our skeleton and musculature have an incredible capacity to support us against gravity while allowing for movement and adaptation. However, over time, we can develop habits that increase the effort needed to stay upright, generating unnecessary tensions and pain.
In the A Better Posture workshop, we will explore simple and gentle movements that help recognize these habits and release accumulated tensions.
As the body discovers new ways to organize itself, it finds more efficient and comfortable support. A better posture emerges naturally, without effort or rigidity, allowing you to move with more freedom and ease.
Less effort to stay upright. More comfort and freedom to move.

aprendendo-a-relaxar.title: Learning to Relax
aprendendo-a-relaxar.shortDescription:
What if relaxing wasn't something you have to do?
Discover how to release unnecessary tension and create space for more calm and presence.
aprendendo-a-relaxar.fullDescription:
Being relaxed is our natural state. Therefore, relaxing is not something we can do, but rather something we can let happen by releasing tension and effort that are no longer necessary. When the body feels safe and comfortable, relaxation happens naturally, and we can better perceive our breathing, our movements, and the habits that influence how we relate to our own body.
In the Learning to Relax workshop, through gentle, effortless movements connected with the breath, we will create the conditions for the body to slow down and the nervous system to find a state of greater calm and restoration.
Relaxation then becomes much more than a pause. It can be a path to expand awareness, perceive what is happening inside us, and discover new possibilities of being in the world.
More calm on the inside. More presence, confidence, and freedom to meet the outside world.

alongar-respirar-e-meditar.title: Stretch, Breathe and Meditate
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.shortDescription: What happens when the body and mind simply stop? Prepare your body, find your breath, and discover a path to meditation.
alongar-respirar-e-meditar.fullDescription:
In our daily lives, we are almost always doing something. Our body and mind have become accustomed to constant movement, action, and stimuli. Therefore, simply sitting, being in silence, and being present can be a challenge.
For meditation to happen, we can first create the conditions for the body to find comfort and stillness.
In the Stretch, Breathe and Meditate workshop, we will explore gentle movements to release the joints and unnecessary tension, finding points of support that allow us to sit with more comfort and stability, keeping the spine erect without rigidity.
The breath will be our companion and an anchor to the present moment, helping to keep attention alert as the body and mind slow down.
By the end, we will have prepared the body and attention to simply sit, breathe, and be.
Without needing to achieve anything. Without needing to do anything. Just creating space for meditation to happen.

transformando-habitos.title: Transforming Habits
transformando-habitos.shortDescription:
Do you choose how you move, or do your habits choose for you?
Recognize your movement patterns and discover new possibilities to move with more freedom, comfort, and ease.
transformando-habitos.fullDescription:
Much of what we do every day happens automatically. These are habits and movement patterns we've learned throughout life that influence our posture, how we move, and even how we feel.
Habits are important. They help us save energy and perform tasks without having to think about every movement. But some patterns that were once useful can over time become limiting, creating tension, discomfort, and unnecessary effort.
In the Transforming Habits workshop, we will recognize these patterns and experience new movement possibilities. By expanding our perception, we can discover different ways to organize the body, with more comfort, efficiency, and freedom.
A habit does not simply need to be eliminated. We can transform it, offering the body new options and allowing it to discover easier, more pleasurable, and more efficient ways to move.
More perception. More possibilities. More freedom to choose how to move.

movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.title: Daily Movements to Prevent Stress
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.shortDescription:
What if a few minutes of movement could change the way you go through your day?
Learn simple movements to release tension, regain balance, and bring more calm to your daily life.
movimentos-diarios-para-prevenir-o-stres.fullDescription:
Stress is our body's natural response to situations that require adaptation. What makes the difference for our well-being is simply how our body responds to it and then manages to return to a state of balance.
In daily life, we can remain in states of alert for long periods, accumulating tension and effort without realizing it. Gradually, this can affect our energy, our concentration, our sleep, our ability to relax, and our overall sense of well-being.
In the Daily Movements to Prevent Stress workshop, we will explore guided sequences of gentle movements that help perceive and release accumulated tension, calm the mind, and direct attention to areas of the body we tend to hold tight.
More than just relaxing for a few moments, we will learn simple movements and strategies that can be incorporated into daily life, creating small pauses to interrupt the accumulation of tension and regain balance.
Learning to perceive stress in the body is the first step to learning to respond to it in a different way.

recuperando-o-foco.title: Regaining Focus
recuperando-o-foco.shortDescription:
What if regaining focus started with the body?
Awaken your attention through movement and discover how more bodily presence can open space for clarity and concentration.
recuperando-o-foco.fullDescription:
In a world full of stimuli and distractions, keeping our attention has become a challenge. We often try to improve our concentration by attempting to control the mind, without realizing that the state of the body also deeply influences our ability to be present.
Inspired by Johann Hari's book, Stolen Focus: Why You Can't Pay Attention—and How to Think Deeply Again, this workshop invites you to turn your attention back to parts of the body that often go unnoticed.
In the Regaining Focus workshop, we will explore simple sequences of movements, performed gently and effortlessly. More than executing the movements correctly, we will pay attention to how we move, noticing details, differences, and new possibilities.
By developing this quality of attention through movement, we expand our bodily perception and can discover more efficient and comfortable ways to organize our movements, reducing unnecessary effort and promoting well-being.
When the body finds safety and can relax, the mind also gains space to slow down. Thus, movement becomes a tool to cultivate presence, attention, and focus.
Regaining focus is also regaining the ability to be truly present in what we are doing.
